blocks.title: Growth and development
blocks.md: **Growth** is a permanent increase in size and dry mass produced by cell division and cell enlargement. **Development** is the increase in complexity of an organism (new organs and structures formed). Growth is measured by height, length or mass; **dry mass** is the best measure for plants (water content varies). In plants, cell division is concentrated in **meristems** at the tips of shoots and roots.

blocks.caption: An S-shaped (sigmoid) growth curve (illustrative).
blocks.alt: A line graph of size against time: slow at first, then a steep rapid-growth phase, then levelling off.

blocks.title: Puberty
blocks.md:
At **puberty** (usually between about 10 and 16 years) the sex hormones cause secondary sexual characteristics.

- **Boys** (testosterone): voice breaks, facial and body hair, broader shoulders, sperm production starts.
- **Girls** (oestrogen): breasts develop, hips widen, periods begin, ovulation starts.

Both sexes: pubic hair, a growth spurt and emotional changes. Everyone develops at their own rate.

blocks.title: Metamorphosis
blocks.md:
Many insects change form completely: **complete metamorphosis**: **egg → larva → pupa → adult** (housefly, mosquito, butterfly). The larva feeds and grows; the adult reproduces. Insects such as cockroaches and grasshoppers have **incomplete metamorphosis**: egg → nymph (a small version of the adult) → adult, with no pupa.

The *Anopheles* mosquito's larvae live in still water, which is why draining stagnant water helps control malaria.

blocks.title: Common mistakes
blocks.md:
- Growth is a *permanent* increase; a meal that increases body mass does not count.
- Fresh mass is a poor measure of growth in plants; use dry mass.
- The pupa stage is missing in incomplete metamorphosis.

blocks.title: Growth rate from data
blocks.statement: On the growth curve above the size is 12 units at time 2 and 52 units at time 6. Calculate the average growth rate between these two times.
steps: Time interval = 6 − 2 = 4 units; rate = 40 ÷ 4 = 10 units per time unit.

blocks.title: Mosquito life cycle
blocks.statement: Place these in order: pupa, egg, adult, larva. Say in which habitat the first three stages live in the mosquito.
steps: Complete metamorphosis: egg → larva → pupa → adult.
Egg, larva and pupa live in still water; only the adult flies.
blocks.answer: egg, larva, pupa, adult; the first three in water.
